(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-content input:not([type="checkbox"])');if(!t)throw Error('Stage reference input missing');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,'Reviewed Demolition, Salvage & Material Scope S01');t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));const c=document.querySelector('.alteration-stage-confirm input');if(!c.checked)c.click();return true})()
(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Review stage geometry');if(!b)throw Error('Review stage geometry button missing');b.click();return true})()

(()=>{const tabs=document.querySelectorAll('.alteration-schedule-tab');if(tabs.length!==5)throw Error('Expected 5 schedule tabs, found: '+tabs.length);const table=document.querySelector('.schedule-materials');if(!table)throw Error('Material schedule table not found in DOM');const btn=document.querySelector('.schedule-csv-btn');if(!btn)throw Error('CSV download button missing');const syncBtn=document.querySelector('.design-sync-btn');if(!syncBtn)throw Error('Sync materials button missing');return true;})()
